findingDetails.title: Post-dispatch write containment can be bypassed through a symlink beneath the artifact directory
findingDetails.evidence: Artifact containment compares lexical Git-status paths and realpath-resolves only the artifact root; the review YAML repeats a resolve-only dirty-path comparison, so a descendant symlink can target outside the physical artifact tree without being detected.
findingDetails.recommendation: Reject symlink components or canonicalize every descendant path/parent before allowing it; add a regression test and retain preventive sandboxing where available.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Source trace across root resolution, status classification and YAML preflight; live escape reproduction intentionally omitted because it would write outside the lineage.

findingDetails.title: Doc-frontmatter harvest accepts a non-fence line as the closing delimiter
findingDetails.evidence: parseDocFrontmatter searches for the first newline followed by --- rather than a complete closing-fence line, so a content line such as ---not-a-fence terminates the parsed block and causes subsequent frontmatter keys or trigger phrases to be ignored.
findingDetails.recommendation: Require the closing marker to be an entire line (--- followed by CRLF, LF, or end-of-input), reject or report malformed fences, and add a regression case for prefix collisions while preserving valid Windows line endings.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Read the scoped parser and consumer documentation; exact source inspection showed a prefix-only closing search and no malformed-delimiter guard.
